author: Unreal Engine
description:
NEW UE 5.6 MOTION TRAILS 2.0: Heat Map & Camera Space Stabilization: Discover the power of the rewritten Motion Trails 2.0 tool introduced in Unreal Engine 5.6, which allows you to visualize movement arcs in 3D space. Customize the display using options like dashed trails for spacing visualization or the crucial Heat Map style to quickly identify speed problems (where red is fast and green is slow movement). Learn how to switch the trail from World Space to Camera Space to stabilize the path relative to the camera shake, which is extremely helpful for debugging cinematic shots

title: NEW UE5 Motion Trails 2.0: Heat Map & Camera Space Stabilization

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Unreal Engine 5's toolset was a strong contributor to helping Valor Mortis' otherworldly 19th-century Europe. Nanite, in particular, helped the team create a more dense, detailed world that was also resource efficient.

Take a journey into our interview with One More Level’s Technical Director, Krzysztof Dalton Pachulski to learn more about it: https://epic.gm/dev-interviews-valor-mortis
title: Valor Mortis and Nanite in Unreal Engine 5

author: Unreal Engine
description:
In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Stockholm, Sandfall Interactive shares their experience of shipping their first game, ‘Clair Obscur: Expedition 33’ as a new studio. 

They discuss the technical challenges with stability, content management, and optimization when scaling up both scope and team, and going from a prototype to a multi-platform commercial release in a project with a lot of legacy assets and loose reference management.

The talk also explores the studio's methods and tools to chunk their packaged game data to support technologies like PlayGo for PS5 and StreamingInstall for Xbox, and their approach to enable late-stage changes without compromising the stability of the game at launch.

Learn more about Unreal Engine here: unrealengine.com

#ClairObscurExpedition33, #SandfallInteractive, #UnrealEngine, #UE5, #UnrealFestStockholm
title: The Technical Journey of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 | Unreal Fest Stockholm 2025

author: Unreal Engine
description:
DYNAMIC PARENTING in UE5: Master Space Switching for IK Hands & Constraints: Discover the Space Switching system which allows you to dynamically adjust the parent relationships for specific character controls, such as an IK hand. Learn how to add custom spaces by selecting targets like the spine or body control anywhere within the rig. Crucially, understand how to keyframe the switch between these different spaces, enabling controls to be locked to the world at one moment and then move dynamically with a different part of the character hierarchy the next

author: Unreal Engine
description:
UE5 POSE LIBRARY SECRETS: Layer Poses Non-Destructively with ADDITIVE MODE: Learn to utilize the Pose Library tool to save, retrieve, and blend different preset poses for character controls, such as hands and faces. Master the powerful new Additive Mode, which allows you to layer the saved pose transformations (the delta) onto an existing pose, rather than overriding it entirely. Discover how to also use the library as a quick selection set utility to instantly grab all relevant controls for posing
